p.src: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

p.src: 1  Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

en: Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:
u.src: 1  Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

p.src: 2  those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

en: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
u.src: 2  those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

p.src: 3  They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
u.src: 3  They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

p.src: 4  LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

en: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
u.src: 4  LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

p.src: 5  The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

en: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
u.src: 5  The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

p.src: 6  I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.

en: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.
u.src: 6  I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.

p.src: 7  LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

en: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
u.src: 7  LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

p.src: 8  LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

en: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
u.src: 8  LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

p.src: 9  As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

en: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
u.src: 9  As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

p.src: 10  Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

en: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
u.src: 10  Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

p.src: 11  An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

en: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
u.src: 11  An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

p.src: 12  I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

en: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
u.src: 12  I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

p.src: 13  Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

en: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
u.src: 13  Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
